# Setup and Data Loading

## Installing and Loading Required Packages

```{r load-packages, eval=TRUE}
# Install packages if needed
if (!require("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!require("nycflights13", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("nycflights13")

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(nycflights13)
```

## Loading the nycflights13 Dataset

The **nycflights13** dataset contains information about all 336,776 flights that departed from New York City airports (JFK, LGA, EWR) in 2013. We'll work with the tables provided by the package directly in memory using `dplyr`.

```{r load-data, eval=TRUE}
# Assign data frames for convenient use
flights_tbl <- nycflights13::flights
airlines_tbl <- nycflights13::airlines
airports_tbl <- nycflights13::airports
planes_tbl <- nycflights13::planes
weather_tbl <- nycflights13::weather

# Check the data
flights_tbl
```

# Selection: filter() {σ}

The `filter()` verb selects rows that satisfy given conditions. It corresponds to the relational algebra selection operator σ.

# Projection: select() {π}

The `select()` verb chooses specific columns from a table. It corresponds to the relational algebra projection operator π.

# Combining filter() and select()

You can chain multiple dplyr operations using the pipe operator `%>%`:

```{r filter-select-combined, eval=FALSE}
# Find delayed flights from Newark, showing only key columns
delayed_ewr <- flights_tbl %>%
    filter(origin == "EWR", dep_delay > 60) %>%
    select(month, day, carrier, flight, dep_delay, arr_delay) %>%
    arrange(desc(dep_delay))

delayed_ewr %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
```

# Aggregation: group_by() and summarise() {γ}

The `group_by()` and `summarise()` verbs compute aggregate statistics for groups of rows.

## Basic Aggregation

```{r aggregate-basic, eval=FALSE}
# Average delays by carrier
carrier_delays <- flights_tbl %>%
    group_by(carrier) %>%
    summarise(
        count = n(),
        avg_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_arr_delay = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_dep_delay = max(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

carrier_delays %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_dep_delay))
```

# Joins: Combining Multiple Tables {⨝}

Joins combine data from multiple tables based on common columns.

## Inner Join

```{r inner-join, eval=FALSE}
# Add airline names to flight data
flights_with_airlines <- flights_tbl %>%
    inner_join(airlines_tbl, by = "carrier") %>%
    select(year, month, day, carrier, name, flight, origin, dest)

flights_with_airlines %>%
    slice_head(n = 6)
```
